findings_queue.finding_title: Remaining-maturity subtraction runs in the wrong direction
findings_queue.current_value: Table (10) - (105) Breakdown of Performing Credit Facilities by maturity
findings_queue.implication: Concrete predicate defect if the table represents remaining maturity as indicated by the future maturity headings. System Date - MATURITY.DATE is negative for future maturities, so a future contract can meet both D6 (<=1) and E6 (<=7), while longer positive bands select past-due contracts. A contract maturing 100 days after the as-of date gives -100 and qualifies for both short buckets rather than the >3 to 6 months band. This is a logic illustration, not a value observed in report data.
findings_queue.required_owner_decision: Set a single reporting as-of date and use maturity_date - as_of_date for remaining tenor if that is the regulatory basis. Define the disposition of matured/overdue and same-day contracts separately, and confirm contractual maturity versus any alternative reporting maturity.

2. Take the Account ID and go to EB.CONTRACT.BALANCES and SUM(OPEN.BALANCE + CREDIT.MVMT + DEBIT.MVMT)
findings_queue.implication: Concrete predicate defect if the table represents remaining maturity as indicated by the future maturity headings. System Date - MATURITY.DATE is negative for future maturities, so a future contract can meet both D6 (<=1) and E6 (<=7), while longer positive bands select past-due contracts. A contract maturing 100 days after the as-of date gives -100 and qualifies for both short buckets rather than the >3 to 6 months band. This is a logic illustration, not a value observed in report data.
findings_queue.required_owner_decision: Set a single reporting as-of date and use maturity_date - as_of_date for remaining tenor if that is the regulatory basis. Define the disposition of matured/overdue and same-day contracts separately, and confirm contractual maturity versus any alternative reporting maturity.

findings_queue.finding_title: Maturity buckets overlap, omit exact boundaries, and do not identify missing maturity
findings_queue.current_value: Without Maturity
findings_queue.implication: Concrete predicate defects independent of which balance group is selected. D6 uses <=1 and E6 <=7 so they overlap; Without Maturity is tested as <=1 day rather than a missing/undefined maturity date. Bands use strictly greater and strictly less comparisons, leaving exactly 30, 90, 180, 365, 730, 1825, 3650 and 7300 uncovered. E4’s >1 Week wording conflicts with E6’s <=7-day test. O6 sums all buckets, so overlap can double-count and gaps can omit contracts. Fixed days also differ from calendar months/years around leap days.
findings_queue.required_owner_decision: Define one mutually exclusive and exhaustive interval model, an explicit missing-maturity bucket, precise inclusivity at every boundary, the intended first-week label, and whether month/year limits use calendar periods or fixed day counts. Validate that each eligible contract reaches exactly one bucket.

findings_queue.finding_title: Direct credit-quality totals include performing exposures twice and indirect performing total uses the next row
findings_queue.current_value: Good / Low Risk
findings_queue.implication: Concrete formula-reference defects relative to the supplied headings, repeated on rows 5, 7-14 and 16-21. F=B+D already totals performing Direct. N=D+F+H+J+L includes performing balances inside Total Non-performing Direct. P=B+D+F+H+J+L counts B and D twice because F=B+D. G uses next-row B/D Direct cells rather than same-row C/E Indirect cells. Illustrative inputs B=100,D=20,H=30,J=40,L=50 yield N=260 rather than 120 and P=360 rather than 240. Mapping cells currently contain specification text, so these formula defects are not evidence of an actual submitted amount.
findings_queue.required_owner_decision: Confirm the existing headings as the intended dimensions. The corresponding structural formulas are F=B+D, G=C+E, N=H+J+L and P=F+N on the same row. Apply only after separating specification text from numeric output and verify totals with independent reconciliation.
